create-table-references: The link table is created with its foreign keys, so no existing rows are scanned while the short catalog lock on the referenced tables is held.
add-foreign-key: The new conflict check table is empty, so its organization and user foreign keys validate no existing rows. The referenced organization and user tables take a bounded lock under the 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
row-level-security: Row security is enabled and forced on the two new empty tables before application code can write them.
create-policy: Policies are catalog-only additions to the two new empty tables and run under the migration's one-second lock timeout.
